% SlideMage template name: Mode shape (test only)
% SlideMage modes: light, dark=Dark slides
% A TEST theme with the shape of an installed institution theme after v0.16.0 (no institution's
% colours): header lines without SPDX lines, a footnote marker command, a palette in mixed case
% with trailing comments, colours of its own, colour-mode data lines with comments, and an
% \input after the base. tests/test_theme_file.py reads and edits it.

\input{SlideMage_setup}

% Footnote markers: the number in a thin rounded box.
\SMSetFootnoteMarkers{boxed}

% Palette.
\definecolor{c_primary_dark}{HTML}{101010}
\definecolor{c_primary_highlight}{HTML}{e0a000}
\definecolor{c_primary_gray}{HTML}{b0b0b0}
\definecolor{c_primary_white}{HTML}{FFFFFF}
\definecolor{c_secondary_violet}{HTML}{8070b0}
\definecolor{c_tertiary_violet}{HTML}{c0b8d8}
\definecolor{c_secondary_blue}{HTML}{5080c0}
\definecolor{c_tertiary_blue}{HTML}{a8c0e0}
\definecolor{c_secondary_green}{HTML}{80b060}
\definecolor{c_tertiary_green}{HTML}{c0d8b0}
\definecolor{c_secondary_red}{HTML}{d06040}
\definecolor{c_tertiary_red}{HTML}{e8b0a0}
\definecolor{c_secondary_orange}{HTML}{e09050}
\definecolor{c_tertiary_orange}{HTML}{f0c8a8}
\definecolor{c_secondary_yellow}{HTML}{f0d050}
\definecolor{c_tertiary_yellow}{HTML}{f8e8a8}
\definecolor{c_tertiary_gray}{HTML}{dddddd}
% A supporting grey, darker than the text (hyperlinks, quote attribution).
\definecolor{c_custom_gray}{HTML}{303030}
\definecolor{c_custom_red}{HTML}{B00000}
\definecolor{c_custom_green}{HTML}{00A040}
\definecolor{c_custom_brown}{HTML}{805020} % supporting brown

% Logo + calibration.
\renewcommand{\SMInstituteLogoPath}{schemes/scheme_test/logo.pdf}
\setlength{\SMLogoHeight}{3ex}
\setlength{\SMFrametitleRightPadding}{0.28cm}

\renewcommand{\SMBulletColor}{c_primary_highlight}
\renewcommand{\SMTitleBoxColor}{c_primary_highlight}
\renewcommand{\SMTitleTextColor}{c_primary_dark}
\renewcommand{\SMFooterBoxColorDefault}{c_primary_highlight}
\renewcommand{\SMFooterTextColor}{c_primary_dark}
\renewcommand{\SMStandoutTextColor}{c_true_black}

% Code panels.
\definecolor{SMCodeKeywordColor}{HTML}{1f5c99}
\definecolor{SMCodeCommentColor}{HTML}{5f5f5f}
\colorlet{SMCodeBackgroundColor}{c_tertiary_gray}

% Colour modes: dark starts from the preset and sets what this theme does differently.
\definecolor{c_test_dark_canvas}{HTML}{2A2A2A}
\definecolor{c_test_dark_card}{HTML}{393939}
\SMDeclareMode{light}{}
\SMDeclareMode{dark}{dark}
\SMSetRole{canvas}{dark}{c_test_dark_canvas}
\SMSetRole{card}{dark}{c_test_dark_card}
\SMSetRole{block_body_text}{dark}{c_true_white}
\SMSetColor{c_tertiary_violet}{dark}{HTML}{393939}
\SMSetColor{c_tertiary_gray}{dark}{HTML}{393939}
\SMSetColor{c_custom_gray}{dark}{HTML}{C6C6C6}  % hyperlinks, buttons, quote attribution
\SMSetColor{c_custom_red}{dark}{HTML}{FF6B6B}   % 5.1:1; also the markers
\SMSetRole{link}{dark}{c_custom_gray}
\SMSetRole{code_panel}{dark}{c_primary_gray}
\SMSetRole{inline_code}{dark}{c_primary_highlight}
\SMSetRole{standout_text}{dark}{c_primary_highlight}

\input{SlideMage_base}

\input{SlideMage_bibliography_default}
